Future<List<Project>> listProjects() async { 
List<Map<String, dynamic>> rawProjects = await -db.rawQuery(''' 
select id, name, colour, 
case archived 
when 'false' then 0 
when 'true' then 1 
when '0' then 0 
when '1' then 1 
when 0 then 0 
when 1 then 1 
else 0 
end as archived 
from projects order by name asc 
'''); 
return rawProjects 
.map((Map<String, dynamic> row) => Project( 
id: row["id"] as int, 
name: row["name"] as String, 
colour: Color(row["colour"] as int), 
archived: (row["archived"] as int?) == 1)) 
.toList(); 
}

Future<List<TimerEntry>> listTimers() async { 
List<Map<String, dynamic>> rawTimers = await -db.rawQuery( 
"select id, project-id, description, start-time, end-time, notes from timers order by start-time asc"); 
return rawTimers 
.map((Map<String, dynamic> row) => TimerEntry( 
id: row["id"] as int, 
projectID: row["project-id"] as int?, 
description: row["description"] as String?, 
startTime: 
DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(row["start-time"] as int), 
endTime: row["end-time"] != null 
? DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(row["end-time"] as int) 
: null, 
notes: row["notes"] as String?)) 
.toList(); 
}
